final_message:
I fixed `slugify` in `slug.mjs`, and `slugify("  Hello -- World! ")` now returns `"hello-world"`. All 3 tests pass with `node --test`.

The old code replaced every non-alphanumeric character with its own dash. I changed it to replace each run of such characters with a single dash, then strip any dashes from the start and end.

I also added a regression test in `slug.test.mjs` using the exact input from the bug report.
